shape.situation_pattern: Two viable paths present equal-looking options (e.g. two edit targets) and the operator is absent.
shape.decision: Weigh trade-offs internally, pick the optimal, move forward, and record the pick in a decision log.
shape.reasoning_physics: Ambiguity that is not irreversible should not tax the human; logging the chosen path lets future reasoners reuse the reasoning instead of re-deciding.
